```{r}
#| label: load
#| message: FALSE
#| include: false
source("pages/_6peak_load.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: latest-run-status
#| include: false
latest_run   <- runs[length(runs)]
latest_id    <- pm |> filter(run_label == latest_run) |> pull(run) |> unique() |> head(1)
sat_latest   <- pm |> filter(run_label == latest_run, peak == n_peaks) |>
  summarise(saturated = sum(!in_range), total = dplyr::n())
res_latest   <- res |> filter(run_label == latest_run) |>
  summarise(mean_resolved = mean(n_resolved, na.rm = TRUE))
sat_ok       <- sat_latest$saturated == 0
sat_status   <- if (sat_ok) {
  paste0(sat_latest$total, " / ", sat_latest$total, " detectors OK")
} else {
  paste0(sat_latest$saturated, " / ", sat_latest$total, " saturated at peak 6")
}
sat_color    <- if (sat_ok) "success" else "warning"
res_status   <- sprintf("%.1f / %d peaks", res_latest$mean_resolved, n_peaks)
res_color    <- if (res_latest$mean_resolved >= n_peaks - 0.5) "success" else "warning"
```

```{r}
#| label: laser-trends
#| include: false
# Per-laser peak-6 deviation from baseline (median intensity + %rCV). Page-local
# derivations from the shared `pm` table -- mirrors the detailed page's
# "Per-laser overview" panel, kept here rather than in _6peak_load.R since it's
# a display-only reshaping, not core metric math.
p6_base_cv <- pm |> filter(peak == n_peaks, in_range) |> group_by(detector) |>
  slice_min(run_label, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  transmute(detector, base_rcv = rcv) |> ungroup()
laser_delta_cv <- pm |> filter(peak == n_peaks, in_range) |>
  left_join(p6_base_cv, by = "detector") |>
  mutate(delta_pct = (rcv - base_rcv) / base_rcv * 100,
         laser = factor(laser_of(detector), levels = laser_levels)) |>
  group_by(laser, run_label) |> summarise(delta_pct = mean(delta_pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Median Q change from baseline per laser (relative, gain-normalised units).
ql <- metrics |> filter(is.finite(Q_d)) |>
  mutate(laser = factor(laser_of(detector), levels = laser_levels)) |>
  group_by(laser, run_label) |> summarise(Qd = median(Q_d, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Cluster-size sanity: mean events per peak per run.
csz <- pm |> group_by(run_label, peak) |>
  summarise(events = mean(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(peak = factor(peak, levels = 1:n_peaks))
```

## {.sidebar}
Data last updated: run **`r latest_run`** (`r n_runs` run(s) total)

Secondary QC for the Aurora EVO from SPHERO **URCP-38-2K** Ultra Rainbow beads
— 6 populations (blank + 5 fluorescent levels). Columns are grouped by theme:
**clustering/gating health**, **intensity & resolution**, and
**sensitivity (Q/B/MEF)**.

This is a compact, card-based companion to the full
[detailed 6-peak Ultra page](AuroraEVO_6PeakUltra.qmd), which carries the
complete per-detector trends, tables, and methodology notes.

See [Help](help.qmd) for QC status definitions.

### Row {height="70%" .tabset}

#### Latest run images

```{r}
#| label: latest-cluster-images
#| output: asis
clus_img <- file.path("../images/6peak_ultra_evo", paste0("cluster2d_", latest_id, ".png"))
gate_img <- file.path("../images/6peak_ultra_evo", paste0("gate_", latest_id, ".png"))
if (file.exists(sub("^\\.\\./", "", clus_img)) && file.exists(sub("^\\.\\./", "", gate_img))) {
  cat(sprintf("::: {layout-ncol=2}\n![Cluster assignment (V8-A x B9-A)](%s)\n\n![Bead gate (FSC-A x SSC-A)](%s)\n:::\n\n",
              clus_img, gate_img))
} else {
  cat("_No saved diagnostic images for the latest run yet._\n\n")
}
```

Latest-run diagnostics only. All runs are on the
[detailed page](AuroraEVO_6PeakUltra.qmd#peak-clustering).

#### Cluster-size sanity

```{r}
#| label: cluster-sizes
#| fig-height: 3
gp(ggplot(csz, aes(factor(peak), events, fill = run_label,
                   text = sprintf("peak %s | %s<br>mean events %.0f", peak, run_label, events))) +
     geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
     labs(title = "Cluster size per peak (events per run; peak 1 = blank)",
          x = "Peak", y = "Events", fill = NULL) +
     theme_bw(base_size = 10), 300)
```

## Intensity & resolution {.tabset}

### %CV trend by laser

::: {layout-ncol=1}

```{r}
#| label: laser-cv-trend
#| fig-height: 3
lim_cv <- max(abs(laser_delta_cv$delta_pct), na.rm = TRUE); if (!is.finite(lim_cv) || lim_cv == 0) lim_cv <- 1
gp(ggplot(laser_delta_cv, aes(run_label, laser, fill = delta_pct,
        text = sprintf("%s laser | %s<br>%+.1f%% vs baseline rCV", laser, run_label, delta_pct))) +
     geom_tile(colour = "white") +
     scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(laser_levels)) +
     scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0,
                          limits = c(-lim_cv, lim_cv), name = "Peak 6\nΔ %rCV\nvs t0") +
     labs(title = "Per-laser peak-6 %rCV deviation from baseline", x = NULL, y = "Laser") +
     theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10)), 300)
```

Per-detector faceted trends (median, %CV, staining index) are on the
[detailed page](AuroraEVO_6PeakUltra.qmd#tracking-over-time) — omitted here to
keep this view fast and scannable.

:::

### Row {height="55%" .tabset}

#### Q trend (relative)

```{r}
#| label: q-trend
#| fig-height: 3.5
gp(ggplot(ql, aes(run_label, Qd, colour = laser, group = laser,
                  text = sprintf("%s laser | %s<br>median ΔQ %.1f%% vs baseline", laser, run_label, Qd))) +
     geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
     labs(title = "Median Q change from baseline per laser", x = NULL, y = "Q change vs baseline (%)") +
     theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)), 320)
```

#### Q heatmap (all detectors)

```{r}
#| label: q-heat
gp(heat(qb, "Q", "Detection efficiency Q", "absolute — gain-normalised; higher = better"))
```

#### MEF detection limit

```{r}
#| label: mef-lod-trend
#| eval: !expr has_mef
#| fig-height: 3.5
gp(ggplot(sens, aes(run_label, MEF_LOD, colour = detector, group = detector,
                    text = sprintf("%s (%s)<br>%s<br>MEF LOD %.0f", detector, fluor, run_label, MEF_LOD))) +
     geom_line() + geom_point() + scale_y_log10() +
     labs(title = "Detection limit (MEF) per anchor detector — URCP-38-2K",
          x = NULL, y = "MEF at detection threshold (log)") +
     theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)), 320)
```
